Thanks, Paula. This in a small wooded area surrounded by suburban development in three directions and Lake Ontario in the fourth, in the middle of the Toronto suburb Scarborough. We've seen deer there before, but never so many or so close.

Snow doe - a white-tailed deer in the snowy dunes along the western shore of Lake Michigan on Saturday. This past weekend was open deer hunting season in Illinois. I read that some hunters are using drones, e-bikes, and ChatGPT to pursue deer these days. Sigh. 🦌

This buck is the first deer I’ve seen at my blind that I could have harvested this year. The DMU I’m archery hunting near Lake Superior is restricted to bucks with 3 or more antlers on one side. No doe licenses available even for archery which is unusual.
A deer by the Lake Ontario lakeshore at our Jack van Nostrand nature reserve.
